usage: 鴿 is a noun referring to the bird pigeon.
You can use 鴿 to talk about the bird itself or the meat from the bird in some contexts.
鴿 works as a singular and can refer to multiple pigeons when the context is clear.
鴿 is often used to talk about pigeons in parks or urban areas where they are common.
